correction_reason: proc refers to the actual retained broker. Preserve owner/child separation by comparing resources.owner and verifying kernel PPid. No authorization, resource, or recovery assertion is removed.
fault_deadline_review: Approval-interruption test bodies remain unchanged. Their existing explicit 700 ms participant and 3000 ms approval settings remain. Healthy constructors omit the optional field and use the accepted production default.
production_fix: Malformed complete frames use the ordinary proxy deadline and reach the authoritative validator. Length, truncation, resource, and Git deadline bounds remain.
primary_review_details: Filesystem workers perform I/O only. Captured paths are copied. Captured descriptors remain owned until the joined future finishes.
SQLite and authorization remain on the broker thread. Completion still flushes before ready state and durable acknowledgement.
Pending-effect callbacks allow checked access and control. Guarded dispatch rejects nested execution, management, and grant mutation with BUSY.
Authority callbacks do not recursively service effects. Callback targets are cleared before local owners destruct.
Git progress retains bounded namespaces, resources, output, argv, and deadlines. The independent low-level entry point remains unchanged.
Retained broker witnesses use actual child pidfds and production child status. The separate owner no longer retains passed child socket endpoints.
Native test provisioning maps each descriptor explicitly. New tests preserve original capacity checks and add resource-bearing exact-capacity and overflow cases.
The witness environment allowlist forwards only two additional qualification paths. Application environments remain unchanged.

Launch remains checked after filesystem waits: NativeLaunch::issue calls the authority checkpoint, ApplicationProcess checks it before setup, and held startup checks it again before release. Pending rows cannot bypass those checks.
